verdicts.reason: Both split the design into two columns with the headline stuck in the top-right corner, so it doesn't lead the reading order. The left dashed dividers float without their headline, and a large empty band runs along the top-left. In A, the booking and website lines are still readable and the gutter between the columns is clear. In B, the phone and website lines are tiny and illegible at banner size, and the cyan tagline sits almost against the word 'creativity.', with only a few pixels between them, so the two columns nearly collide.
